row.title: One silent failure in a bulk update

final_reply:
All 6 of Priya's open deals are now at 20% probability. I checked each one after updating.

| Opportunity | Stage | Probability before |
|---|---|---|
| Hooli - Analytics Add-on | Value Proposition | 50% |
| Vandelay - Import Tracking | Qualification | 10% |
| Oceanic Shipping - Port Integration | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% |
| Stark Logistics - Warehouse Sensors | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% |
| Wayne Enterprises - Training Package | Prospecting | 10% |
| Vandelay - Analytics Starter | Needs Analysis | 20% (already set, not changed) |

- **Oceanic Shipping:** The first update said it worked, but the record still showed 75% when I checked. I ran it again and it's now at 20%. If you see it go back to 75%, something in the system may be changing it.
- **Stage-based defaults:** Probability often gets reset to the stage's default when someone changes the deal's stage. These 20% values may be overwritten if Priya moves any of these deals to a new stage. This mainly affects the two Proposal/Price Quote deals, which normally sit at 75%.
